== Course of events ==

After days spent preparing the balloon — Dorothy and Oz sewing green silk strips together and coating the fabric with glue to make it airtight — and following three anxious days in which Dorothy waited without word from him, Oz summoned her on the fourth day. He told her he could not make a cyclone, and proposed instead that they cross the desert together by balloon.

This summons came after the balloon's public preparations were already under way: a clothes basket had been fastened to it, and Oz had announced to the crowd that he was going to visit a brother Wizard who lived in the clouds. Calling Dorothy to him on the fourth day marked the point where that announced departure became a direct plan involving her.

What followed built on this proposal: Oz explained that the silk, coated in glue, would let the balloon float on hot air rather than gas, then lit a fire beneath it to fill it, declaring that the Scarecrow would rule in his absence. It was in this same stretch that Oz revealed his intention to leave with Dorothy, admitting he was tired of ruling in secret as a humbug.
